name: Gordo's Task
summary: Along the road to Brill, Gordo gathers plants for the Royal Apothecary Society. His clumsy hands make the work too fine, so he asks travelers to gather Gloom Weed for Junior Apothecary Holland.

sections.title: A Clumsy Laborer
sections.body: Between Deathknell and Brill, Gordo trudges through the countryside on the Royal Apothecary Society's behalf. Abominations can fight with brute strength and carry heavy loads, but their huge, stitched hands struggle with delicate work. Sent to gather ingredients in the meadows, Gordo crushes more stems than he plucks. So he turns to passersby, bullying or bribing them to do the careful work for him.

sections.title: Apothecary Frustrations
sections.body: Junior Apothecary Holland waits for the delivery in the graveyard behind Brill's town hall. Gordo misunderstood his orders. Holland needs volatile Doom Weed for alchemical research, but Gordo sent travelers to gather harmless Gloom Weed. The mistake leaves Holland thoroughly exasperated. He takes it as proof that Gordo is useless and sends you to correct the error.

faq.answer: Gordo is an abomination bound to the Royal Apothecary Society. He patrols the meadows west of Brill and carries out labor assigned by his master, Junior Apothecary Holland.

faq.q: Why does Gordo need help gathering weeds?
faq.answer: Gordo's enormous, stitched hands lack the dexterity to pick delicate plants without ruining them. So he recruits traveling Forsaken to gather the flora.

Junior Apothecary Holland is an alchemist with the Royal Apothecary Society, stationed in the Brill graveyard. He oversees Gordo and researches local flora and blighted soil to aid the Forsaken war effort.

faq.q: Why is Holland upset when the Gloom Weed is delivered?
faq.answer: Holland is upset because he needs volatile Doom Weed for alchemical research, but Gordo sent you to gather harmless Gloom Weed.

faq.q: Where can Gloom Weed be found?
faq.answer: Gloom Weed grows close to the ground in the fields between Deathknell and Brill, especially in the open meadows east of Solliden Farmstead.

faq.q: What happens after completing Gordo's Task?
faq.answer: Afterward, Holland offers you another assignment, Doom Weed, in Brill's graveyard.

angles.text: As a trained herbalist, you can easily find Gloom Weed patches among the blighted grass.
As a newly risen Forsaken leaving Deathknell, you meet the clumsy realities of abomination labor and the Royal Apothecary Society's sharp temper.
